bagPolicy.summary: The Hall permits one bag per ticket holder in the auditorium; additional or oversized bags must go to the cloakroom for £2 per item. Its safety guidance asks guests to avoid bringing large bags.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
